params.message:
The team checks and shapes a trend, beside what gentells.com will show

A check desk on Insights and a check on each trend's page; a field to shape
the text with a prompt; a framed preview of the site's trend page that
follows a rewrite. With it, a design system: spacing, type and depth tokens
and shared content pieces (Card, Status, Facts, Stat, ListRow, Empty).

Portal: In de Observatory keurt de redactie trends goed, herschrijft ze met een opdracht, en ziet meteen hoe ze op gentells.com staan.
